pages.text:
## Exam
Gen: ill-appearing, AOx4 via interpreter
R forearm: 6 x 5 cm fluctuant area volar aspect with surrounding erythema 12 cm, no crepitus, full finger ROM, compartments soft
CV: tachycardic
## Assessment/Plan
Sepsis due to R forearm abscess.
1. Bedside I&D in ED - purulent material sent for culture; packing placed
2. Blood cx x2, vancomycin IV + cefazolin IV pending cultures, IVF 30 mL/kg
3. Hand surgery consult - no deep space infection on exam; I&D adequate
4. Tetanus booster given
5. DVT ppx: enoxaparin 40 mg SC daily
Signed: Mikhail Petrov, MD 06/01/2026 13:20
